affected_party: QIF adopters and accountable quality authorities
actual_problem: Contradictory calibration evidence can be archived without proving that QIF changed, was deliberately rejected, or was rolled back.
why_it_matters: A framework that records evidence but cannot close the learning loop may preserve a known false assumption.
why_now: QIF v0.6.27 through v0.6.29 made empirical origin, suite health, and uncertainty executable; framework learning is the remaining calibration-readiness blocker.
